# Third-party assets

Models used by the 3D map. All are CC0 (public domain): no attribution is required, but we credit the authors anyway. Each folder keeps the original `License.txt`. Only the models the map uses were copied in.

| Folder | Pack | Author | Licence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kenney_nature_kit/` | Nature Kit 2.1 (trees, palms, bushes) | Kenney | CC0 1.0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit |
| `kenney_car_kit/` | Car Kit 3.1 (parked cars) | Kenney | CC0 1.0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/car-kit |
| `kenney_city_kit_roads/` | City Kit Roads 2.2 (street lamps, pillars) | Kenney | CC0 1.0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-roads |
| `kenney_furniture_kit/` | Furniture Kit 2.0 (desks, chairs, tables, shelves) | Kenney | CC0 1.0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit |

The foliage colours are changed in code (`scenes/map3d/ModelLibrary.gd`) to tropical greens.
Everything else on the map (buildings, roads, the gate, the canteen, students) is generated in code.
